# THE HOMESTUD

> > THE HOMESTUD is a home improvement and DIY renovation resource featuring IKEA hacks, kitchen design guides, hydroponic gardening tutorials, and budget-friendly home projects.

The site documents real renovation projects like the Beige Bungalow and The Partridge House in Edmonton, while providing practical how-to guides for DIY enthusiasts. Content spans indoor renovations, outdoor hardscaping, furniture hacks, and urban gardening with a focus on budget-conscious solutions.

## Key Topics

- IKEA hacks and furniture customization
- Kitchen design and renovation
- Hydroponic gardening systems
- Budget home renovations
- Beige Bungalow project
- The Partridge House project
- Basement finishing and bars
- Outdoor living spaces
- Decks vs patios comparison
- DIY furniture builds
- Home design software
- Kallax and Brimnes modifications
- Soil testing and gardening
- Edmonton home projects
- Hardscaping and landscaping

## Kitchen Design & Renovation

- [The major kitchen design mistakes you need to avoid](https://www.thehomestud.com/the-major-kitchen-design-mistakes-you-need-to-avoid): Common kitchen design mistakes: workflow, work triangle, and layout tips
- [24 IKEA kitchen organization and storage ideas](https://www.thehomestud.com/ikea-kitchen-organization-and-storage): 24 IKEA kitchen organization hacks for drawers, cabinets, and pantry
- [The toe-kick drawer: How to hack your kitchen storage](https://www.thehomestud.com/diy-cabinet-toe-kick-drawers-hidden-kitchen-storage): DIY toe-kick drawer build guide for hidden IKEA cabinet storage
- [Why you should NOT buy IKEA kitchen appliances?](https://www.thehomestud.com/ikea-kitchen-appliances): IKEA appliances review vs Frigidaire, Electrolux, and Whirlpool brands
- [How to install laminate countertop edge strips](https://www.thehomestud.com/how-to-install-laminate-countertop-edge-strips): Step-by-step laminate countertop edge strip installation tutorial

## IKEA Hacks & DIY Furniture

- [Luxury home bar on a budget](https://www.thehomestud.com/luxury-home-bar-on-a-budget): IKEA hack home bar using Brimnes and Kallax with shiplap and butcher block
- [Basement Bar Ideas on a Budget](https://www.thehomestud.com/basement-bar): Budget basement bar build using IKEA and Restore materials
- [IKEA hack! The kallax/brimnes farmhouse countertop](https://www.thehomestud.com/ikea-hack-kallax-farmhouse-countertop): DIY farmhouse countertop using IKEA Kallax/Brimnes and Kreg jig
- [How I customized a free IKEA Kallax into office storage](https://www.thehomestud.com/ikea-kallax-into-office-storage): IKEA Kallax hack with plywood waterfall edge for office storage
- [How to make your hollow core door look expensive](https://www.thehomestud.com/modern-hollow-core-door-update): Budget hollow core door makeover with geometric accent design under $50

## Hydroponic & Urban Gardening

- [Hydroponic systems: What are they and how do they work?](https://www.thehomestud.com/basic-hydroponic-systems): Six hydroponic systems explained: DWC, wick, ebb & flow, NFT, drip, aero
- [The lowdown on general hydroponic nutrients](https://www.thehomestud.com/general-hydroponic-nutrients): Guide to hydroponic nutrients including House & Garden and Aqua flakes
- [Five easy DIY Soil tests](https://www.thehomestud.com/diy-soil-tests): Five DIY soil health tests including squeeze test and earthworm checks
